8-01.check: SELECT name, upper(type) AS type, CASE WHEN pk = 1 THEN NULL ELSE "notnull" END AS not_null, pk FROM pragma_table_info('wishlists') ORDER BY cid

8-02.check: SELECT product_id, quantity FROM stock ORDER BY product_id

8-03.check: SELECT "table" AS ref_table, "from" AS from_column, "to" AS to_column FROM pragma_foreign_key_list('restock_requests')

8-04.check: SELECT COUNT(*) AS products, SUM(stock_quantity) AS total_stock, (SELECT "notnull" FROM pragma_table_info('products') WHERE name = 'stock_quantity') AS not_null, (SELECT CAST(trim(dflt_value, '()') AS INTEGER) FROM pragma_table_info('products') WHERE name = 'stock_quantity') AS default_value FROM products

8-05.check: SELECT (SELECT type FROM sqlite_master WHERE name = 'monthly_sales') AS object_type, month, sales FROM monthly_sales WHERE month >= '2026-07' ORDER BY month

8-06.check: SELECT COUNT(*) AS kept_reviews, SUM(rating) AS rating_sum, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT user_id, product_id FROM reviews_unique GROUP BY user_id, product_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)) AS dup_pairs FROM reviews_unique
